name: HiBob
description: HR platform for mid-size businesses. Monitor employee records and workforce data.

config.setupInstructions:
1. Log in to HiBob Admin
2. Go to Settings > Integrations > Service Users
3. Create a new Service User and grant it People read permission
4. Copy the Service User ID and the generated Token
5. Paste both below — HiBob requires HTTP Basic auth with id:token

credentialFields.label: Service User ID
credentialFields.helpText: The Service User ID shown in HiBob > Settings > Integrations > Service Users (e.g. SERVICE-12345).

credentialFields.label: Service User Token
credentialFields.helpText: The token generated alongside the Service User in HiBob.
